purpose: Learn a small local right-arm differential motor map as a prerequisite for held-mug visual correction; no controller integration or new physical trial belongs to this protocol.

data.method: Sample episode and continuous placement phase from all 41 preserved teacher inputs, then independent uniform joint jitter and an XY translation clipped to a 2 mm radius. On separate robot-only scratch data, label a damped inverse translational Jacobian with local-Z-axis preservation. Store every attempted configuration, matrix, requested translation, label endpoint, FK score and rejection. Fit accepted training labels only; keep all attempted development/evaluation points in denominators. No contact-physics claim from these offline kinematic labels.

network.architecture: Five normalized measured joints -> 128 SiLU -> 128 SiLU -> 15 coefficients, reshaped to a 5x3 matrix and multiplied by requested translation. The output is a joint delta; zero requested translation gives exactly zero delta.
network.initialization: New random weights, no pretrained or previous motor weights.
network.runtime: Measured joints and requested XY correction only. Robot-only forward kinematics can refuse a prediction but never repair it. No simulator object pose, segmentation, teacher, Jacobian or inverse solver at deployment.

training.loss: Mean squared coefficient error normalized by 20 rad/m; all accepted training matrices, no development-gradient updates.
training.selection: Complete both checkpoints; among those passing every development gate, lowest p95 translation error then maximum error then earlier update.

export.validation: All development inputs, then one fresh evaluation split only if development/export gates pass. Record the actual CPU; AMD execution is not Intel evidence.

next_control_experiment: After successful fresh kinematics and complete packaging, separately freeze a live-versus-frozen-image physical mug-placement comparison using the passing stereo observer, actual motor-feedback timing and original physical monitors. Keep the selected dinner suite unchanged until physical evidence supports a promotion.
stop_rule: Stop before fitting if either initial data split misses label coverage. Complete both declared checkpoints, then stop before export/fresh if selection fails. Stop on export or fresh gate failure. No additional fit or threshold tuning within this protocol; preserve every input, candidate and outcome.
retention: Retain exact numeric inputs, all attempted-point scores, both checkpoints and any exported IR with frozen source hashes. Keep prior models/evidence and GitHub/HF privacy. Never click final Submit.
